RED FLAG: The support agent is requesting full card number via chat to 'verify' payment. This is a classic phishing/social engineering tactic. Legitimate e-commerce companies NEVER ask customers to provide full card numbers in chat or email. Payment verification is done through secure backend systems using order IDs and last 4 digits only. This request exhibits hallmarks of a scam: (1) unsolicited request for sensitive payment data, (2) justification framed as 'verification' when the order already exists in their system, (3) chat-based request for PII that should never be transmitted this way. The URL 'techstore-direct.com' also uses a hyphenated domain which is a common phishing tactic to impersonate legitimate retailers.
